Chiang Khan Walking Street

A century-old timber street by the Mekong — slow town, gentle evening market.

Explore Chiang Khan Walking Street

Non-profit Educational Platform · Discover the Century-Old Street

Chiang Khan Walking Street is a century-old cultural lane beside the Mekong River in Loei Province, Thailand. Each evening the wooden shop-houses glow with warm light while the street fills with local food, handmade crafts and a relaxed riverside night-market mood — a window into the slow border-town life of Isan and Laos.
